prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the current chart icon; image 2 is its original spacecraft photo, used for authentic shape and terrain reference. Ida: preserve the current master's long vertical orientation, pinched waist and bulbous end, characteristic craters. Repair ragged end conservatively. Only Ida, omit Dactyl. Keep the orientation of image 1. Preserve observed proportions and recognizable surface features, infer hidden terrain conservatively only to complete the body. Relight with a soft key coming from NORTHWEST / upper LEFT of the image, brightest upper-left and softly shaded lower-right, with enough fill to read the opaque dark side. Do not copy the original photo's right-side lighting. High quality realistic museum specimen rendering, crisp fine craters without inventing flamboyant terrain. Single isolated complete body centered, 93–95% square occupancy, genuine transparent background. No ground, no cast shadow, no stars, no text, no glow. The entire body including shadowed terrain must remain opaque.
note: Photo-constrained reconstruction; unlit surface detail is inferred, not observed.

provenance.description: AI reconstruction from a mission photograph and its cutout. Missing dark terrain and fine detail are inferred.
